rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Secure MCP server by fakoli that bridges Claude Code with OpenAI and Google Gemini APIs, featuring multi-layer security protection including prompt injection detection, content filtering, input sanitization, and configurable rate limiting. The implementation provides granular security controls with basic/moderate/strict modes, supports all major OpenAI models (GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini) and Gemini variants (1.5 Pro/Flash), and includes performance optimizations like pattern caching and early termination for fast validation. Built with comprehensive error handling, structured logging, and extensive test coverage, it serves developers who need secure AI API access with enterprise-grade protection against malicious prompts, content policy violations, and API abuse while maintaining flexibility for legitimate use cases.
